a_start_process_desc: Run an external program (path to its .exe file)
a_lock_workstation_desc: Immediately locks the current Windows session
a_open_url_desc: Opens a URL with the system's default application (browser)
s_start_process_exe_path_desc: Absolute path to the application's .exe file (e.g., C:\Program Files\App\app.exe)
s_invoke_script_path_desc: Absolute path to the script file (e.g., C:\Scripts\run.ps1)
s_invoke_script_show_shell_desc: Open a console window while running the script (otherwise runs hidden)
s_open_url_desc: Absolute URL starting with http or https (e.g., https://mobro.app)
